as_told.title: LiDAR over the Amazon reveals geoglyphs

plain: Laser scans taken from aircraft over the Amazon rainforest, a method called lidar that sees through the tree cover, are said to show that the region once held tens of millions of people, large cities with permanent populations, and huge, precise geometric earthworks that can only be seen whole from the air. The writer Graham Hancock describes these findings, connected to the second season of his television series Ancient Apocalypse. Jesse Michels later recalls hearing it from Hancock, though he mentions only the shapes cut into the land showing through the treetops, and it matters because it would rewrite what is known of the Amazon's past.
